Something not of this world is about to turn one teacher’s life upside down.
Watch the TERRESTRIAL Official Trailer (2026), the new alien sci-fi horror film from Indican Pictures. 

The movie follows Dave, an unhappy high-school science teacher whose life takes a bizarre turn when he discovers what appears to be a dead alien inside a Hawaiian lava tube. What seems like the discovery of a lifetime quickly becomes something far more dangerous as the creature begins bringing chaos and destruction to the school.
